instruction:
Design a system that combines the functionalities of the adder-subtractor module and the 3-bit splitter module. The system should take in two 32-bit inputs and perform addition or subtraction based on a select input. The output should be three separate 1-bit outputs representing the most significant bit, middle bit, and least significant bit of the result, as well as the 32-bit sum or difference. The system should include an additional functional module that takes in the three 1-bit outputs and outputs a single 3-bit binary number, representing the same value.

The adder-subtractor module should use a combination of a 16-bit carry-select adder instantiated twice and a 32-bit XOR gate to perform the arithmetic operations, with the sub input connected to the carry-in of the adder. The 3-bit splitter module should be designed using a combinational logic architecture without using any multiplexers or demultiplexers.
